fresh_resource_scheme: drumee-v1-<24 cryptographically random hex>-data/-consumer; new attempt UUID and 48-hex nonce; no pre-existing resource adoption

planned_resources.creation_proof: nonexisting exact random name, exact successful create, observed metadata fingerprint/nonce/owner/attempt/daemon plus receipt

planned_resources.lifecycle: current-attempt interactive Node stdin holder with SIGTERM handler; network none, no host ports, read-only/non-root/cap-drop/no-new-privileges, read-only exact owned volume mount

phases: Capture immediate global metadata before mutation
Create and inspect exactly one local owned volume and persist manifest/creation receipt
Create exact owned container; verify actual Mounts and refuse cleanup in created state
Start owned container; verify running reference and refuse cleanup
Controlled stop owned container; verify stopped reference and refuse cleanup
Remove exact verified owned container non-force; assert no all-state consumer remains
Inject removal failure through test double before actual rm, retain original error and verify volume still exists
Re-read daemon, exact volume metadata and all-state references twice; exact non-force volume rm
Verify absence/no consumers; global before/after metadata equality; persist result/removal receipts
refusal_requirement: Harness must throw VOLUME_IN_USE before any Docker volume rm; daemon error alone insufficient
failure_policy: Preserve primary failure and separate cleanup errors; perform only exact positively owned cleanup; no retry, broad selector or unverified deletion; stop after attempt
sensitive_data: Container Env/volume option/label contents may be inspected in memory but only selected metadata or hashes retained; no volume content mount/read for unknown objects.
partial_creation_limitation: LOW static auditability observation retained: structured manifest follows inspect/ID checks; command/start evidence plus global final inventory guard detects ordinary unmanifested survivors. No false successful campaign/security bypass demonstrated. No production or ownership-contract redesign. Unknown partially attributed resource remains protected and causes failed qualification.
historical_boundary: H01-H04 never adopted/deleted; current inventory 682 volumes/35 containers/21 networks is not an ownership grant. Historical daemon ID unknown.
foreign_boundary: No unrelated volume/container/network operation except read-only metadata; no host filesystem mounts or external network; no image build/pull

post_campaign_read_only_verification.commands: Re-read exact owned resource absence and same daemon; bounded past-window Docker container events filtered by exact org.drumee.qualification attempt label, no live observer/no future --until
post_campaign_read_only_verification.required_evidence: Correlate exact created container ID and die exitCode with owned lifecycle; preserve actual start/stop/destroy events and non-force deletion commands; no hidden transport/process exit accepted
post_campaign_read_only_verification.boundary: This adds read-only evidence retrieval, not a second campaign or fixture action. No source/harness change. Any missing mandatory termination evidence remains blocked rather than fabricated.
